title: DeepSwapper face swap: free limits, video access & alternatives
summary: DeepSwapper guide with its real interface, photo and video access, policy conflicts, practical workflows and alternatives for your own footage.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**DeepSwapper advertises free photo face swaps without signup or watermarks.**


Its public video pages disagree about whether a subscription is required. Confirm video access before committing, or compare another browser workflow or local FaceFusion setup.


### Swap a face in your own video


Start with a short clip and a clear replacement portrait. Review the complete result before extending the project.


[Try Video Face Swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap/video)


You want to try DeepSwapper without finding out halfway through that the free offer covers a different job. Its photo offer sounds straightforward, but the public video pages give conflicting messages about subscription access. That matters when you already have a clip ready to upload.


This guide separates the photo workflow from the unresolved video questions and explains what to check before paying. You’ll also find browser and local alternatives, plus practical privacy and export checks. Start with the kind of swap you need, then decide whether the offer you can actually access fits it.

## Use the correct DeepSwapper site


**DeepSwapper advertises free, unlimited photo face swaps without signup or watermarks.** Video access needs a closer check: its video landing page says free, while its homepage FAQ says a subscription is required. For your own video or a broader editing workflow, compare Magic Hour; for local controls, consider FaceFusion. Verify the offered limits and rights before committing.


For the broader category, start with our[AI face swap tools guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/ai-face-swap-tools) . This page answers the narrower DeepSwapper buying decision: what its free offer covers, which questions remain unresolved, and which workflow to choose next.


The product covered here is[deepswapper.com](https://www.deepswapper.com/) . DeepSwapper and DeepSwap are different services. A price, refund promise or tutorial for one does not establish the other’s behavior. If you meant DeepSwap, use our separate[DeepSwap pricing and workflow guide](https://magichour.ai/blog/deepswap-ai-review) .


This distinction matters when a search result sends you to a similarly named tool. Confirm the domain before uploading a face or entering billing details. Keep the product name and account in your project notes so that a later support request goes to the service that actually processed the file.


## What the current interface shows


Observed interface, October 12, 2026: the original-media input and replacement-face input are separate, with photo, video and multi-face routes. Screenshot from the official public site, before any upload. This is interface evidence, not a generated result.


Treat the two inputs as different roles. The original image or clip supplies the scene, pose and action. The replacement face supplies identity. Accidentally reversing them changes the job. Before processing, name both files clearly and keep an untouched original for comparison.


## How to approach a photo face swap


For a simple photo experiment, begin with one visible adult face and material you are authorized to use. A neutral, well-lit replacement portrait makes the identity easier to inspect. Use an original image with a compatible head angle; heavy blur, a tiny face or an obstruction gives you less usable facial information.


Open the image route, choose the original image, then choose the replacement face. Check the selected files before starting. Afterward, compare the result with the original at full size: look at eyes, mouth, jaw edges, hairline and the boundary against glasses or a hand. A plausible thumbnail can conceal a poor edit.


### Watch DeepSwapper’s photo-swap steps


DeepSwapper’s own short tutorial illustrates its face-swap workflow. It was published in June 2024; use the current site to verify the selected photo or video mode, limits and download rather than treating the video’s “free” title as today’s entitlement.[Watch the source video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s8a9YLCJGgQ)


For a group image, write down which person should change and which should stay. Verify that mapping both before and after processing. If only one identity needs replacement, a successful edit should leave the others appropriate to the task; a tool detecting several faces does not by itself prove correct mapping.


Keep your acceptance rule narrow. For an informal invitation, a small boundary defect may be acceptable. For a paid portrait or advertisement, it may not be. Choose the standard before retrying rather than treating every additional attempt as an automatic improvement.


## Is DeepSwapper video face swap free?


The answer is not settled by a free headline. DeepSwapper’s[video landing page](https://www.deepswapper.com/ai-free-video-face-swap) presents free video face swap, but the[homepage FAQ](https://www.deepswapper.com/) says video requires a subscription. We did not complete a video request or checkout, so we cannot verify which entitlement applies to a particular account.


Before a long clip, check four things in the actual offered workflow: whether your file is accepted, whether generation requires payment, what duration and resolution are included, and whether downloading the finished result adds a restriction. An upload picker alone does not establish free processing or free export.


Start with a short consented clip containing a turn or expression change. Watch the full result at normal speed, then revisit moments where the face moves behind another object. Do not use a single poster frame as evidence that identity remains stable throughout the video.


If you already own the clip and want a direct alternative,[Magic Hour’s video face swap](https://magichour.ai/products/face-swap/video) provides a browser route for the original video and replacement face. Confirm the displayed limits and settings for the selected route. Face swapping and replacing spoken dialogue remain separate jobs.


## Pricing: compare the offer you can actually buy


Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative. DeepSwapper’s public tool, FAQ and policies were reviewed on October 12, 2026. We inspected its interface, but did not submit a generation or purchase a subscription. Vendor descriptions, observed interface details and our task-based recommendations are identified separately.


We are not quoting a numeric DeepSwapper subscription price because this review did not verify a current checkout. A number copied from a directory, an older screenshot or an unrendered configuration is weaker evidence than the offer attached to your account.


For a paid job, record the charge, renewal interval, included allowance, expiry, supported duration and download resolution. Also record whether unused allowance survives renewal or cancellation, and what happens to an unsuccessful request. If the interface does not answer one of those questions, ask before buying a large allowance.


An illustrative budget makes the difference clearer: suppose a project needs six approved clips and you allow two attempts per clip. You need capacity for twelve attempts, not six. That is a planning example, not a DeepSwapper credit measurement. Substitute the provider’s confirmed charge for your exact mode and add editing time separately.


Keep a small project log: input filename, selected route, offered charge, completion state and whether you accepted the output. It helps distinguish a genuinely useful edit from a completed request you would never publish. A lower advertised unit price does not automatically mean a lower finished-project cost.


## Check commercial permission before client work


DeepSwapper’s homepage FAQ allows commercial use, while[section 3 of its Terms of Service](https://www.deepswapper.com/terms.html) describes personal use. The Terms page is dated January 1, 2024. We cannot resolve that inconsistency into a blanket permission or prohibition for every current plan.


For advertising, client work or resale, request written confirmation naming the product, plan and intended use. Keep that answer with the terms and offer available when you purchase. A watermark-free download is an export feature; it is not proof of permission to use somebody else’s likeness, footage or music.


A useful project permission check has two parts. First, establish that your provider permits the intended use. Second, establish that you can use the inputs and publish the resulting depiction. Consent to a private experiment does not necessarily cover a public endorsement or a paid campaign.


## Privacy: separate processing from saved history


The[DeepSwapper privacy policy](https://www.deepswapper.com/privacy.html) describes ephemeral server processing of face data and also addresses account information, logs and service providers. Separately, its homepage FAQ says media can be stored when save-history or save-faces options are enabled. The camera-processing language does not explain how its retention promises apply to uploaded files or saved history; that applicability remains unresolved.


We did not independently test deletion or retention. Before a confidential project, confirm what is uploaded, whether account history is enabled, how saved faces can be removed, and what retention applies after deletion. Avoid turning a statement about one type of face data into a claim that the entire service stores no information.


For an initial workflow check, use a fictional adult or a person who has clearly authorized the edit. Remove unnecessary personal details from the files. If local processing is a requirement rather than a preference, consider a local workflow and review its own network, storage and model-license choices.


## Cancellation and refunds need a separate check


DeepSwapper’s[cancellation policy](https://www.deepswapper.com/cancellation.html) dated September 10, 2024 calls for cancellation at least 24 hours before the next cycle and says possible refunds require that credits have not been used. Its general Terms contain broader refund wording. Obtain clarification before treating either description as an unconditional money-back guarantee.


Record the next renewal date and retain the cancellation confirmation. Canceling future renewal differs from receiving a refund for a completed purchase. If the account controls or offer do not match the published policy, resolve the discrepancy with support before relying on a deadline.

Look at the resulting identity and facial boundaries while comparing clothing and background with the original. It does not establish video consistency, processing speed, a guest-tool allowance or current cost.


For your own decision, use the same authorized target and replacement portrait across the shortlisted workflows. Keep the downloaded files together. If one result is unsuitable, record the actual defect—wrong identity, a visible seam or altered surroundings—before changing the input. An attractive example on a marketing page cannot replace that project-specific check.


## The decision for a real project


DeepSwapper is worth examining for a casual photo edit when its offered workflow matches your needs. For video, paid work or sensitive inputs, the documentation conflicts are part of the buying decision. Resolve the relevant entitlement, permission and retention questions before committing a deadline or a large file set.


If the task is simply swapping a face in footage you already own, test one short clip with the same source portrait on your shortlisted tools. Approve identity, motion, boundaries and the final download. Choose the workflow that meets those requirements at a confirmed cost; this article does not establish a universal quality winner.
